info.name: Atlassian Delete Previous Revision of Snippet

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

items.docs: This API operation allows you to delete a specific previous revision of a snippet in Atlassian Bitbucket by providing the workspace identifier, the encoded snippet ID, and the node ID of the particular revision you want to remove. The deletion is permanent and removes only the specified historical version while preserving other revisions and the current state of the snippet.
